feature.title: Favorites（收藏）
feature.finding: 补充文本明确 Favorites 位于顶部，且更换 Profile 会看到不同 Favorites；存在移动 Favorite(s) 到其他 Profile 的菜单描述。
feature.limits: Profile 关联有明确文本支持；“同 Profile 的所有 Spaces 都共享相同 Favorites”尚缺直接共享状态证据。图标尺寸、区域位置没有截图。该项没有独立 REA 行为证据。

supplementary_static_text.text: Favorites keep your most used sites and apps close
starting with your Favorites at the top.
Each Profile has different browser data, so you might get logged out of some websites, see different Favorites up top, or need to re-install extensions.
Submenu to chose which profile to move Favorite(s) to.
